summary: Comprehensive 3-phase backend release and hardening plan for Helm.Warning.Backend covering critical hardening (input validation, schema validation, structured JSON logging, exception framework, centralized config), enhanced reliability (metrics, Prometheus instrumentation, expanded unit & property-based tests, caching, batching), and advanced features (Redis caching, circuit breakers, and asynchronous pipeline orchestration) with configurable per-feed triage escalation.
